title: Batch Geocode output
description: One dataset row per address/coordinate, plus REPORT.md, GEOJSON, SUMMARY (and MATRIX when Distance Matrix is enabled) in the default key-value store.

results.title: Geocode results
results.description: Dataset rows: input, provider, status, lat, lng, formattedAddress, locationType, accuracy, providerId, components, confidence, errorClass, hint.

geojson.title: GeoJSON FeatureCollection (GEOJSON)
geojson.description: Successful points as GeoJSON Point features.

reportMarkdown.title: Markdown report (REPORT.md)
reportMarkdown.description: Summary counts, result table, failure hints and how to get a key.

summary.title: Run summary (SUMMARY)
summary.description: ok, failed, byClass, apiKeyProvided, charged, durationSecs, peakMemoryMb.

matrix.title: Distance Matrix (MATRIX)
matrix.description: Only when enableDistanceMatrix is on: origin, destination, distanceMeters, durationSecs, status.
